hero.title: Useful technology, built to remain yours.
hero.lede: Lowcountry Digital Works is an owner-operated technology consultancy helping small organizations improve websites, automate business work, untangle digital ownership, and solve technical problems without unnecessary platform sprawl.

trustPoints: Configure and integrate before unnecessary custom build
Clear handoff, recovery, and ongoing-care boundaries

heroProof.title: Technology should stay understandable after the project.
items: Named, scoped access instead of shared administrator credentials
Low recurring-cost bias and portable source where practical
Validation, documentation, and rollback treated as normal delivery quality

services.title: Start with the business problem, not a product.
services.intro: LDW works across websites, business systems, digital ownership, and technical planning. Existing platforms and maintained tools come first when they solve the need well.

ownership.title: Your business should own its digital assets.
ownership.lede: Domains, DNS, website and hosting accounts, repositories, cloud services, business profiles, and other critical systems should be held in business-controlled primary accounts wherever practical.
items: MFA and recovery responsibility made explicit

process.title: Assess → Improve or Build → Handoff or Care

steps.title: Assess
steps.description: Understand the real need, current systems, constraints, ownership, risk, and cost before choosing technology.

steps.title: Improve or build
steps.description: Keep useful systems when possible. Configure, integrate, automate, or build only what the problem actually requires.

steps.title: Handoff or care
steps.description: Leave clear ownership and documentation, then continue with bounded ongoing care only when it creates useful value.

founder.title: Work directly with the person responsible for the work.
founder.name: Eddie Gugino
founder.lede: Eddie founded Lowcountry Digital Works to bring practical IT, cybersecurity, and technical-delivery discipline to small-business technology work without importing enterprise-sized complexity.
founder.note: The public founder photo and final background wording remain subject to owner approval before production.

local.title: Local perspective, not a geographic limit.
local.lede: Lowcountry Digital Works is based in South Carolina's Lowcountry and supports practical digital work where the engagement, ownership model, and support boundary are a good fit.

contact.title: Have a website, workflow, or technical system that needs to work better?
contact.lede: A short description of what is happening now and what you want to improve is enough to start.
